analysis.cluster: whole instance; all arms and all three policy seeds move together
analysis.fisher_exact: two-sided Fisher exact tests accompany binary contrasts, including PACT versus ACT and PACT versus PACT_ZERO; pooled Fisher tests are labeled cluster-unaware descriptive statistics and never replace the whole-instance bootstrap
analysis.method: paired mean differences with deterministic whole-instance cluster bootstrap

co_primary_endpoints.collision_free_task_success: task_success AND zero hazard_bar contact entries AND zero other_environment contact entries
co_primary_endpoints.hazard_bar_contact_frames_per_rollout: number of physics audit frames containing one or more hazard_bar contacts

tokens.CONTACT_EXPERIMENT_INCOMPLETE: the fixed 1,200-row schedule does not reconcile
tokens.CONTACT_INCREASE: pooled PACT-minus-PERMUTED contact-frame CI is strictly above zero
tokens.CONTACT_REDUCTION_ESTABLISHED: pooled PACT-minus-PERMUTED contact-frame CI is strictly below zero and PACT-minus-PERMUTED contact-frame difference is negative in every seed, without satisfying the task-benefit clause
tokens.CONTACT_REDUCTION_SUBSET_ONLY: reserved for reduction confined to a viable preregistered occlusion subset; unavailable because the geometry-only partition was degenerate and dropped before rollouts
tokens.CONTACT_REDUCTION_WITH_TASK_BENEFIT: pooled PACT-minus-PERMUTED contact-frame CI is strictly below zero; PACT-minus-PERMUTED contact-frame difference is negative in every seed; pooled PACT-minus-ACT collision-free task-success difference is positive; and PACT-minus-ACT collision-free task-success difference is positive in every seed
tokens.NO_CONTACT_REDUCTION: the pooled contact-frame CI includes zero, or a pooled reduction excludes zero but its sign is not negative in every seed

diagnostic: hazard-bar contact-frame paired contrast restricted to seed-instance pairs in which both compared arms achieved manipulation success

populations.occlusion_partition_result: 285 of 285 eligible recorded episodes classified vision-disadvantaged
populations.occlusion_rule: active panel outside wrist frustum or occluded for at least 50% of pre-grasp steps

storage.other_rows: retain endpoint-complete result and SHA-256 inventory, then irreversibly delete trajectory/video payload bytes

training: existing seeds 3101/3102 plus independently initialized matched ACT/PACT seed 3103; identical 2000-epoch recipe
